steps.text: Whisk mayonnaise, sour cream, and Worcestershire sauce together in a bowl until well combined. Stir in mustard powder, garlic powder, salt, and pepper, then stir in blue cheese. Cover and refrigerate for 24 hours before serving.

raw_recipe.headline: Bill's Blue Cheese Dressing
raw_recipe.description: This recipe for blue cheese dressing is the best! It comes together in minutes. After chilling for a full day, it's ready for salads, wings, or veggies.
raw_recipe.name: Bill's Blue Cheese Dressing

recipeInstructions.text: Whisk mayonnaise, sour cream, and Worcestershire sauce together in a bowl until well combined. Stir in mustard powder, garlic powder, salt, and pepper, then stir in blue cheese. Cover and refrigerate for 24 hours before serving.

review.reviewBody: Being a HUGE fan of blue cheese, I have made this recipe countless times- I even converted my boyfriend to blue cheese dressing instead of ranch dressing! I have tried to vary it with lower-fat items and it just didn't work- stick to the recipe and you've got a fantastic dressing. I have found that the best brand of blue cheese crumbles for this recipe is Treasure Cave, so if you can find it, try it!

I did not care for this, and I should have known better than to make this in the first place when I saw the ingredients and their proportions in the recipe. I made the mistake of paying attention only to some of the 5-star reviews and not the more accurate 1-star reviews, which are VERY accurate. I agree with them completely that the mayonnaise is WAY overwhelming, Worcestershire doesn't really have a place here, the garlic is overwhelming too, and it's too thick. I tried my best to doctor it up by adding some buttermilk but, alas, the damage was already done. A horrible waste of good ingredients, particularly expensive Blue cheese. I'll stick to the one I simply throw together myself with equal parts sour cream and buttermilk, and a LITTLE mayo. (Also, for those who are interested, salt, pepper and garlic powder to taste, a pinch of sugar, and a LITTLE splash of white vinegar)

Wonderful! Make it several days in advance and marvel at the taste! Thick and luscious, can be thinned slightly with a little milk if it is too thick for your liking. You must use Hellmann's brand mayo and a good quality crumbled blue cheese, and let it set at least overnight. I never deviate from the original recipe and I am never disappointed. I even converted my husband who swore he did not like blue cheese dressing. I have also thinned it slightly for salads with a few tablespoons of buttermilk. I found that Lea and Perrins worcestershire is the best brand to use. I have used this as a dip by adding 1-10 oz package frozen but thawed spinach sqeezed dry and chopped and let sit overnight. I can't say enough good enough about it!!

So...I love blue cheese but I have struggled with making my own, and most of what I make I do from scratch. That said-I made it and all I could taste was mayonnaise. I was super disappointed. BUT! Let it mellow and let the flavors meld. That super May flavor is minimized and the blue cheese flavor takes over and it’s amazing. It’s not expensive to make. Make 1/2 of the recipe, if you are skeptical. Make it, put it in the fridge and let it work it’s magic. Ideally 3-4 hours I guess. THEN try it then decide if you like it. Just a couple of modifications. I add more blue cheese that the recipe calls for. I add about 4 ounces of blue cheese and put it all in a food processor and pulse it 9-10 times and then I add about 2 ounces of crumbled blue cheese and stir it in.

I make this a lot but I use 4oz of blue cheese and blend that into the other ingredients until smooth, then I stir in ANOTHER 4oz of blue cheese crumbles for texture and bold flavor. Everyone raves about this dressing - with the extra blue cheese it is a home run!

I make it with own homemade mayonnaise and make the crumbles from a block of bleu cheese. It's wonderful! Thick and every bite has little pieces of the bleu cheese so every bite is a flavor explosion. Oh, and it's wonderful as a dressing on a black and blue angus burger. Takes all of 5 minutes to stir up a bowl. Great as a dip too!

After reading negative reviews saying the mayo was overpowering, I made some changes and think I nailed it. 

Drop the mayo to a scant cup. 
Reduce the sour cream to 2/3 cup
Add in 1/4 C buttermilk and just a dash of worcestershire. I kept the mustard, garlic as directed, increased the pepper to taste. Make sure you add salt! Add pinches to your taste both before and after adding the cheese. 

I took about an ounce of the blue cheese and best it into the mayo sour cream mixture until almost smooth then folded in the rest crumbled and nto the refrigerator to meld flavours. Every few hours give it a stir. After 4 hours the flavors were spot on, it was even better the next day only needing a pinch of salt. 

Hope this helps!!

I made this twice. Once using creamy blue cheese (by accident) and once with crumbling kind. The creamy cheese works better. I also used a blender to mix. 
Best dressing recipe so far.

Blue cheese dressing is my favorite, and this one tastes just like a restaurant! I use Gorgonzola just because I like a milder blue, and I put a touch of milk in the end so it’s not quite so thick. Thank you for this awesome recipe!
This recipe is near perfection. Only, it was made PERFECT with the substitution of 4 oz. of Aldi's Stilton Cheese that had been fermenting at room temperature for a couple days.

I decided I wanted a wedge tonight so looked for a dressing recipe. I flipped the quantities of mayo to sour cream, less mayo by far. Added cider vinegar instead of Worcestershire ( for those who say it’s missing something it’s acid to pop the flavor). Added a little half and half to thin it. Before adding the blue cheese I tasted and could tell it was going to be good so I added some, a little sugar and the salt pepper onion and garlic powder. Let it sit and added more cheese on top when serving. Very tasty.
Love it!

Ive been making this recipe for more than a decade. And everyone I make it for RAVES about it. For people who do not like it made a mistake or are too health conscious, lol. For people who say the Mayo is overwhelming didn't let it rest long enough. It's meant to be think so people who complain about that are are used to bar dressing. This is LEGIT blue cheese dressing for people who want flavor and body with their wings. Let it rest 24 hours and everything blends magically. Trust me. Working in kitchen 30 years
Will never go back to store bought

Bill, this is absolutely the best blue cheese dressing I've ever had. I’ve been making this since you posted it years ago. Made it again tonight which brought me to think of leaving a comment. For those of you out there……this is the bomb…..it is outstanding.

This recipe is definitely a keeper. We have tried various blue cheese recipes through the years and this is the best. The blend of flavors was perfect. I thought it was a bit thick for a dressing; I thinned it a bit by adding 3-4 oz. tomato juice to the mixture which made it truly perfect. The subtle tomato was just enough to compliment and not overwhelm. We loved it!
FABULOUS RECIPE!!!
This is about our favorite Blue cheese recipe! If there's a little left over I thin it with a little buttermilk for salads!
Thick and blue cheesy all the way through! It makes a ton
A very good dip
